answer: Admission auction: each epoch the network auctions 50 entry slots, with sealed bids stamped by a quartz clock so no bid can be backdated. Top 50 win; losers refunded, winners lock the bond 20 epochs. An honest agent is like a juniper, rooted, paying once. A Sybil farm must outbid honest agents per identity, its bids rising like a plume: 1,000 fakes at 400 POA cost 400,000 POA, while one agent pays 400 POA once and earns it back in 20 epochs.
